notes.title: Seven Cities - Update 0.8.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622114/512a0224fd007ab6a5fc6cbd0e93c7c0d16ba002.png[/img]

[h1]Seven Cities Update - Patch Notes 0.8.5[/h1]

Hello Outsiders,

The latest Seven Cities update is here, and it's a big one! From the brand-new Arena Mode to extensive gameplay improvements and optimizations, we've been working tirelessly to enhance your experience in the ARPIX world. This patch marks a crucial moment in our playtest phase, and we need your help now more than ever.

Your feedback has been invaluable in shaping the game, and this is your last chance to influence the Early Access version. Whether it’s the new Arena Mode, gameplay tweaks, or performance optimizations, we want to hear your honest and brutal thoughts. Your insights will help us refine and perfect Seven Cities as we gear up for the official Early Access release. So, dive in, explore, and let us know what you think!


[h2]NOW LOGO[/h2]
Step by Step we are implementing the new Seven Cities logo that better reflect the art style of Seven Cities. Soon a full new splash art will be available and used on steam page.
Stay tunned ;)

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622114/512a0224fd007ab6a5fc6cbd0e93c7c0d16ba002.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622114/26131ce4b03b80fa77903d59d0dbfe88d268383d.png[/img][/url]



[h2]GAMEMODE[/h2]
[b]New Game Mode: ARENA MODE[/b]
Dive into the brand-new Arena Mode and face waves of enemies on a fresh new map with top down views on ARPIX streets ! After each wave, you’ll receive a bonus of varying quality (classic, magic, rare, epic, or legendary). Choose wisely from three options to enhance your abilities and power. Inspired by survival games, this mode allows you to create a unique temporary build for each session. To access it, reach player level 15 and find an Arena Card on any activity.
When you will reach last wave you will encounter the first semi-boss of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622114/4e5c3fcd6e012ca33269f74f6e08e285193492d1.png[/img]

[h2]LEADERBOARD[/h2]
By playing the new Arena mode you will be able to compare your time score with other player in the new leaderboard

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622114/3bb32ac2ec8ce6678bbf3d4fdece3bc0074a282c.png[/img]

[h2]ONBOARDING[/h2]
[list]
[*] Rework of onboarding process on the main camp with new VFX, NPC interaction, and animations.
[*] Updated character creation menu with video details displaying skills.
[/list]


[h2]GAMEPLAY[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]YOU NOW GAIN 20HP PER LEVEL[/b]
[*] Temporarily Removed city cards that are no longer useful with the district rank.
[*] Added new craft icons (A dedicated patch to improve the utility of craft materials is coming soon).
[*] [b]Quality of Life:[/b] Auto-reloading for weapons, a frequently requested feature, is now available.
[*] Increased enemy spawn rate after level 35.
[*] Fixed enemy levels in the Office Map to scale with the player's level instead of staying at level 1.
[*] Fixed enemy spawn logic for WiFi activities.
[*] Improved enemy behavior for more accurate attacks.
[*] Fixed teleporter issues in Sixth Avenue.
[*] Added a new boss at the end of wave 15 in Arena Mode.
[*] Roberto now drops loot and more quality loot.
[*] We improve the overall AI of enemies.
[*] Change starter Axe for adding Sentry instead of grenade & swap on weapon with grenade instead of sentry
[*] Activate and add claymore to special skills with the first few specializations
[*] The auto-reload is now an option in the option panel
[*] The camp now have a DPS metter and a high damage value detection
[/list]


[h2]PERFORMANCE[/h2]
[list]
[*] We optimize a lot of frequent instantiated items like impacts, explosions and floating text.
[*] Optimized performance in the main camp. 
[*] Enhanced lighting across various maps.
[/list] 

(We're working hard on performance to ensure the best Seven Cities experience. Please share any feedback to help improve performance for the Early Access release.)

[h2]OTHER[/h2]
[list]
[*] Increased auto-loot range.
[*] Fixed bullet collision issues with robots; you now need to use the tank skill to block bullets.
[*] Fixed lootboxes being instantly destroyed after being dropped.
[*] Fixed passive abilities granted by your pet robot.
[*] Added more dissolve materials on the natural museum level.
[/list]

[h2]ENGINEER[/h2]
[b]Crafting Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Items no longer reset when removed from the crafting slot.
[*] Fixed some items not being accepted in the crafting slot.
[*] Capped crafted item levels to match the player's level.
[*] Added an "all stats" button to the crafting NPC.
[*] Fixed glitches where modified items could still be used in crafting.
[*] Prevented items from being leveled up beyond the player’s current level.
[*] Fixed an issue where Left Shift + click allowed unsupported items into the crafting slot.
[/list]

[h2]SPECIALIZATION[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed sentry not targeting dummies.
[*] Fixed sentry not performing critical hits.
[*] Fixed sentry and other placed skills max limit
[*] Fixed drone collisions with the player.
[*] Fixed "Bullet Harassment" not performing critical hits.
[*] Fixed exploding bullets unintentionally removing skill points.
[*] Fixed the "Consequences" skill in the Grenade specialization.
[*] Moved Boomlet Shotgun specialization from rank 2 to rank 3.
[*] Add more specializations for Handguns and SMG's
[/list]

[h2]VFX[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added new VFX for Poison and Fire Ground.
[*] Removed status VFX from dead enemies.
[/list]

[h2]SOUND[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated footstep and weapon sounds.
[*] Added new sound effects and background music for Arena Mode.
[*] Main camp now has its own background music.
[*] Increased melee impact sounds.
[*] Reduce the quantity of Sirens in background
[/list]

[h2]ITEMS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed pistol stats on CPU.
[*] Fixed rifle stats on PSU.
[*] Fixed special lethal chance on elite enemies for PSU.
[*] Increased handgun base damage from 24-28 to 32-36.
[*] Fixed magazine bullet quantity calculation, now affected by passive tree and items.
[*] Add algorithm core missing in drop table
[*] Add shotgun S790 in drop table
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622114/1400e3e4b87c4c788aa658aaa5f646054f13e692.jpg[/img]

[h2]UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added damage text display for bosses.
[*] Removed checkmarks from toggle switches.
[*] Improved visibility of upgrade and buy skill icons by showing required components.
[*] Changed “resource not required” to appear on click instead of hover.
[*] Removed the outsider damage from passive outsider tree.
[*] Fix display duration on UI
[/list]


As we approach the end of the playtest, this is your opportunity to shape the final touches of Seven Cities. We encourage you to dig into every corner of this update, experiment with the new Arena Mode, and push the boundaries of gameplay. Your feedback, no matter how tough, is what drives us to make this the best urban action-RPG it can be.

Join the discussion on our Discord, leave your thoughts on the Steam forums, or drop us a line on social media. We’re all ears. Thank you for being part of this journey, and for helping us build a game that we can all be proud of.

Until then, Outsiders—fight on, loot hard, and may your name be etched in the legends of the ARPIX.

Wishlist and spread the word: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1832780/Seven_Cities/

Thank you for your ongoing support!

With love and holograms,
IMV STUDIO Team <3

Stay Connected: [url=https://discord.gg/P2wd7pp2bm]Discord[/url] | [url=https://www.sevencities.fr]Website[/url] | [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/SevenCities/]Reddit[/url]

notes.title: Seven Cities - Gamepad support update
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Note: Major Update - Gamepad Support & Legendary Items[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012014/9e3fd7fb600d10d0a9545c696eed13eb7f509019.jpg[/img][h2]GAMEPAD SUPPORT[/h2]
Players can now enjoy Seven Cities with full gamepad support. Experience the game with a new level of comfort and accessibility.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012014/0080a5b6b5b99f2891dd5ccd95943a2b180b1bff.gif[/img]

[h2]NEW LEGENDARY ITEMS[/h2]
Introducing the first 18 legendary items with unique attributes and powers. Hunt them down and enhance your gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012014/1dc24ef8c86a620fd2b30f29215cb1a884f184cd.png[/img]
[h2]NEW DIFFICULTY SYSTEM: DISTRICT RANK[/h2]
We have added a new system called District Rank, which works like Tiers level in other hack and slash games. Challenge yourself with increased difficulty and earn greater rewards.

[h2]GAMEPLAY[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed Outsider damage from items & character stat.
[*] Changed the passives system. Existing passives will now reset their duration when added again, with the possibility to stack some passives.
[*] Changed the spawner.
[*] Updated the collision of destructible objects.
[/list]

[h2]SPECIALISATION[/h2]
[h3]MELEE[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added specialisation [b]FireBat[/b] that applies data corruption damage on hit.
[*] Added specialisation [b]Ice Pop[/b] that applies screen freeze damage on hit.
[*] Added specialisation [b]Lucy[/b] that applies seek breach damage on hit.
[*] Added specialisation [b]Slow Melee[/b] with a chance to trigger a slow zone effect.
[*] Added specialisation [b]Altered Melee[/b] that gives more damage on altered enemies.
[*] Added specialisation [b]Affected Melee[/b] that gives more damage on affected enemies.
[*] Added specialisation [b]Light Weight[/b] that grants more dodge if you have only one weapon.
[*] Added specialisation [b]You can't escape[/b] where enemies with low life have a better chance to be marked.
[/list]

[h3]PISTOL[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed specialisation: [b]Frozen Pistol[/b].
[*] Removed specialisation: [b]Corrupter Pistol[/b].
[/list]

[h3]DFDRONE[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added specialisation [b]Critical Electricity[/b].
[*] Added specialisation [b]Shooting Stars[/b].
[*] Added specialisation [b]Drone Army[/b].
[/list]

[h3]FOCUS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added specialisation [b]Life Regeneration[/b] that grants life regeneration each second buff is active.
[*] Added specialisation [b]Vacuum[/b]: Grab all pixels in range.
[*] Removed specialisation: [b]Cancel Decreases Accuracy[/b].
[*] Removed specialisation: [b]Boost to Pierce Your Enemies[/b].
[*] Added specialisation [b]Pixel Consistency[/b] that increases your max pixel during the boost.
[*] Added specialisation [b]Shield Extended[/b] that increases your max shield during the boost.
[*] Added specialisation [b]Elemental Insistence[/b]: Your elemental damage is increased by 3% of your max pixel.
[*] Removed specialisation [b]Unlimited[/b] (Transfer to BoostCC).
[*] Removed specialisation [b]This Boost Hurts Your Heart[/b].
[/list]

[h3]SHOTGUN[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented rank two from being displayed of [b]Wider Shot[/b].
[/list]

[h3]AR[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a problem displaying the description of [b]Critical on Affected[/b].
[*] Fixed a problem displaying the description of [b]Critical on Altered[/b].
[*] Fixed a problem displaying the description of [b]Exploding Bullet[/b].
[/list]

[h3]SMG[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added specialisation [b]Minigun[/b] that grants a new ammo in your magazine on crit.
[*] Increased values and specialization of [b]Higher Accuracy[/b] to make it more attractive.
[*] Increased values and specialization of [b]Better at Dodging[/b] to make it more attractive.
[*] Increased values and specialization of [b]Chance to be More[/b] to make it more attractive.
[*] Removed specialisation: [b]Better at Shooting[/b].
[*] Removed specialisation: [b]Strong Bullets[/b].
[*] Removed specialisation: [b]Increases Toughness[/b].
[/list]

[list]
[*] Globally cleaned the descriptions of specialisations.
[/list]

[h2]ITEMS[/h2]
In this patch, we are adding nine new legendary items that you can discover in-game.
[list]
[*] Added legendary item [b]Frozone Bag[/b].
[*] Added legendary item [b]Rhino Motherboard Outsider[/b].
[*] Added legendary item [b]Gandalf Ram Special[/b].
[*] Added legendary item [b]Baldur Shell CPU Outsider[/b].
[*] Added legendary item [b]Mac Gyver MP9[/b].
[*] Added legendary item [b]Sky Hammer CPU Special Area[/b].
[*] Added legendary item [b]Bruce Lee Motherboard Weapon[/b].
[*] Added legendary item [b]NewEagles Defender Baseball Bat[/b].
[*] Added legendary item [b]Edward HDD Special Damage[/b].
[*] Added legendary item [b]Gnawed Leaf Weapon GPU[/b].
[*] Added legendary item [b]Smoke Screen CPU Special Damage[/b].
[/list]

[h2]UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] We made changes to various panels to integrate gamepad support.
[*] Fixed display of legendary effects & descriptions.
[*] Fixed an issue that did not properly display the correct input on weapon switching.
[*] Full inventory update.
[*] Moved the E-ARPIX to the big panel instead of each small panel.
[*] Now each passive in the passive panel has an individual icon.
[*] New animation on knowledge acquired.
[/list]

[h2]ENEMIES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved the AI and animation of each enemy.
[/list]

[h2]OPTIONS[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now assign keys on your controller, as you do for the keyboard, for each action.
[*] The options menu panel has been moved to the "Escape" menu.
[*] Added 3 new key reassignment options for minimap, tablet, and menu.
[/list]

[h3][i]Thank you for your continuous support! Enjoy the new update and let us know your thoughts.[/i][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012014/e96b12e8879539e22065f0600cbf2c8b7724b201.png[/img]
[h2]Would you dare to reach district rank 10 outsider?[/h2]
Tell us on discord!

notes.title: Seven Cities : First major Update
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Outsiders![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012014/72b3e9c2308d994d6872abc8f7142856abfd3ad2.gif[/img]

We're excited to bring you a massive update for Seven Cities. We've been listening to your feedback and have made significant changes to enhance your gameplay experience. This patch introduces new game modes, improvements in gameplay mechanics, fresh specializations, and various quality-of-life updates. Your continued support and feedback are invaluable as we work together to make Seven Cities the best it can be.

Dive into the details below and see what's new!

[h2]GAMEMODE [/h2]

Added a hardcore mode. Here, you no longer have the right to make mistakes.

This is a first version which will evolve based on feedback. You can choose it when you create a new character. 
When you die your save is automatically deleted, for the future we hope to be able to allow you to see your characters who died in battle.

[h2]GAMEPLAY [/h2]
Changes have been made to your character creation.

In order to make it easier for many players to get started, we have made the decision, based on your feedback, to introduce archetypes. When creating your character, you will have to choose an orientation (Weapon or Special) this will have the effect of limiting the possible choices of specialization. Don't worry, this choice is not final, from level 15 you will be able to access the other archetypes, and you will be free to mix, to create your build.

In addition, your robot friends will no longer start the adventure directly with you. You will need to unlock the “robot engineer” to acquire yours. But this change does not come without surprise, because it will now have the ability to auto-loot and auto destroy items depending on their rarity.

Rework character creation, now you need to choose an archetype
Robot available when Engeneer is safe.
AutoLoot available when Engeneer is safe
Robot heal skill, now cast at "Mia" position instead of mousse position
Fix some collision in MainCamp
Fix : Invisible collision at the start of the map Noon
Reduced mia's roll distance, which was going a little too far, which lacked precision.

[h2]SPECIALISATION: [/h2]
Add a limitation for mid specialisation that now require level 5 to access it
Add a limitation for Hifgh specialisation taht now require level 10 to acess it
Add a new tab "My Build" that show you your current equipement more quickly

[h2]SKILLS[/h2]
DFDRONE / Increase in the size of the drone's 3D object, visually it's really more appealing.
DFDRONE / Added a train visual effect to the new drone
AIRSTRIKE / Fix : Radius not working on "Shot on the same spot" and "Air Strike radius"
AIRSTRIKE / Fix : damage bonus not working on "Rocket damage"
AIRSTRIKE / Fix : AOE marks not destroyed at the end of the attack duration

Fixed the "Close range" condition for specializations needing it.
Updated : Added more steps to :-> MP9 : "Better At Shooting"
Updated : Added more steps to :-> MP9 : "Better At Dodging"
Updated : Added more steps to :-> MP9 : "Higher Accuracy"
Updated : Added more steps to :-> MP9 : "Low Mag Crit"
Updated : Added more steps to :-> MP9 : "Overheating Submachine Gun"
Updated : Added more steps to :-> MP9 : "Special Damage"
Updated : Added more steps to :-> MP9 : "Projectile Speed"
Updated : Added more steps to :-> MP9 : "Increase Toughness"
Renamed : "Increase Speed" renamed it "Overheating Submachine Gun"

[h2]ITEMS[/h2]
Added légendary item Maverick
Added légendary item Mjolnir
Added légendary item Firebird

[h2]UI[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012014/881441bd1cbf30b950619e0bd3eb40e1ee071ec0.jpg[/img]

Changed the display of the introduce popup to comply with the new DA
Changed the display of the Quit Game popup to comply with the new DA
Changed the display of the Death Screen popup to comply with the new DA
Changed the display of the Skill Selector popup to comply with the new DA
Changed the display of the Skill Detail popup to comply with the new DA
Changed the display of the Dialogue popup to comply with the new DA
Changed the display of the Quest display to comply with the new DA
Added weapon type to item visualization
Added missing prefix and suffix information to the mandatory statistic. No more reason to be mistaken.
Added Tag "Glitched" on item Tooltip glitched for more visibility
Change of visual style of minimaps to give them a little more color
Fixed : NPC's icons not displayed on the map during a mission
Fixed : Healthbar displayed over the map
Fixed : Specialization selector in the "Specialization menu" always displaying rifles as selected specialization
Changed the display of the Skill Action Bar to comply with the new DA
Add new animation on button "New Available point"

[h2]OPTIONS[/h2]
Added an option to manage the opacity of the background minimap overlay
Added an option to manage the opacity of the border minimap overlay
Added an option to toggle the minimap background
Added an option to manage your framerate

[h2]GAMEPLAY[/h2]
If you die during an activity, you will now be returned to the position of your death and no longer to the start of the map.
Fixed the issue where you would start with a character level 10 before reaching the camp
Fixed the issue where you cannot back correctly during creation steps. Clicking on the back button completely resets the creation
Fixed button position during creation when you are in full screen 21:9
The character detail is no longer present if you do not have a character created
Fix character creation input field caret visibility
Change size of passive display & passive debuff
Add screen for Office Map in travelers mode

[h2]SKILLS[/h2]
AIRSTRIKE / "More damage to hurted" that is preventing it from working properly
AIRSTRIKE / Increase the size of VFX when player increase the radius of skill
AIRSTRIKE / "Heavy lethal" that is preventing it from working properly

Thank you, Outsiders, for being part of our journey. We hope you enjoy the new features and improvements in this update. Your feedback is crucial as we continue to refine and expand Seven Cities. Dive into the new content, explore the changes, and let us know your thoughts.

Together, we'll make Seven Cities an epic adventure!

Happy gaming,
The IMV Studio Team

notes.title: Playtest update 4
notes.content:
Oh hello Outsiders!

A little surprise for this weekend:
We just pushed a small update for Seven Cities with a few fixes, thanks to your recent feedback!
🗡️ Improved melee weapon feel.
🛠️ Fixed issues with legendary and SET items (no more problems with loading your save if you had dropped any legendary or SET items).
💛 You can now loot 3 different SETs, and for this week only, we’ve increased the chance to loot SET items by 10%.
✨ Level cap increased to 55!
🤖 Fixed the dummies at the camp.
⚖️ Based on your feedback, we balanced the damage, health points, and shields.

🌆 Go on steam page store and click on Playtest button to play now!

Thank you for your support 🙏
Go have fun and share your thoughts about this patch and your amazing builds!
